verdict: McDonald's grew revenue 10% to $7.0B and operating profit 10% to $3.2B — comparable sales rose 5.7% worldwide, with the U.S. up 6.8% as value promotions brought in more guests.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: vs a year ago (+6% in constant currencies)

segments.name: Franchised restaurants
segments.note: Rent and royalties paid by the local owners who run most McDonald's restaurants — the heart of the business model.

segments.name: Company-owned restaurants
segments.note: Food and drink sold at restaurants McDonald's runs itself.

segments.name: Other revenues
segments.note: Fees from franchisees for technology and digital platforms, plus brand-licensing income.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Head office, marketing support and running the global franchising machine — includes $123M of depreciation and amortization.

takeaways.title: Comps rose everywhere
takeaways.text: Global comparable sales rose 5.7% with positive guest counts — the U.S. +6.8% on successful value promotions, International Operated Markets +5.2% and licensed markets +4.5%. Systemwide sales across all restaurants rose 11%.

takeaways.title: EPS rose 8%
takeaways.text: Diluted EPS was $3.03, up 8%. Excluding $80M of net pre-tax charges tied to 'Accelerating the Organization', it was $3.12, up 10%. Operating income rose 10% to $3.2B.

takeaways.title: Franchisees carry the model
takeaways.text: Franchise revenue — rent and royalties from other people's restaurants — was $4.3B, 61% of all revenue. Company-run stores brought in most of the rest at much thinner margins.

oneTimers: Net pre-tax charges of $80M ($0.09 per share), primarily restructuring charges under the 'Accelerating the Organization' program to modernize how the company works; excluding them, operating income rose 13%.
otherDetail: Interest expense of $410M on McDonald's debt, partly offset by $12M of net nonoperating income.
footerNote: The release's printed lines are rounded: they sum to pre-tax income of $2,758M vs the $2,757M printed; this page follows the printed net income of $2,164M.
segmentNote: Systemwide sales grew 8% to $58.4B; comparable sales: U.S. +6.8%, International Operated Markets +5.2%, International Developmental Licensed Markets +4.3.
